artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.descri:
{Naga Harpoon Launcher}

The latest invention by armament scientists, a powerful tool for destroying enemy troops.
artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.event: The universal war machine Naga Harpoon Launcher allows you to attack enemy city walls.
artifact.naga-town.harpoonlaucher.name: Naga Harpoon Launcher
town.naga-town.naga.blacksmith.descripti: The Blacksmith provides your army with Naga Harpoon Launchers.
town.naga-town.naga.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith

building.naga-town.naga.capitol.name: Capitol

building.naga-town.naga.castle.name: Castle
building.naga-town.naga.citadel.descript: The Citadel not only increases the base growth rate of creatures by 50% but also strengthens the town's defense facilities.
building.naga-town.naga.citadel.name: Citadel
building.naga-town.naga.cityHall.descrip: The City Hall allows you to purchase town buildings and provides you with 2000 gold per day.

creatures.naga-town.nagalv4th.descriptio:
{Skill Description}:
{Summon Water Elemental} Naga Tidecallers can summon Water Elementals, with the number summoned equal to the number of Naga Tidecallers.
faction.naga-town.naga.name: Naga
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.biography: Athissa has exceptional talent and a special affinity for tidal forces in the dark. During her magical training, Athissa finally discovered her control over tides, thus earning the title 'Tide Mother'.
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.name: Tide Mother Athissa
hero.naga-town.nagaathissa.specialty.des: Tidal Power reduces the speed of all enemy units by -1.
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.biography: Delacour is the chieftain of the Dragon Turtle clan, which was originally a friendly race living in the Dense Mist Abyss until enslaved by Queen Azshara as war machines for the Naga. Queen Azshara awakened the ancestral power within Delacour, causing him to lose self-consciousness. Delacour's ancestral power can trigger the raging form of the Dragon Turtle clan.
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.name: Delacour
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.specialty.de: Upgrades Naga Dragon Turtles to Raging Dragon Turtles.
hero.naga-town.nagadelacour.specialty.to: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Raging Dragon Turtles
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.biography: Parjesh is the captain of Queen Azshara's royal guard. The Naga royal guard he leads is directly under Queen Azshara's jurisdiction, and only the most elite warriors among the Naga Guards are promoted to royal guard members, known as Naga Royal Guards.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.name: Parjesh
hero.naga-town.nagaheroparjesh.specialty: Can upgrade Naga Guards to Naga Royal Guards.
Creature Bonus: Upgrade Creature: Naga Royal Guards
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.biography: Slark is the leader of the Murloc Warriors. The Murloc Warriors he leads are the most dangerous predators among the Murlocs. Their superior assassination skills make it impossible for enemies to track them, delivering the most fatal strikes in critical moments.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.name: Slark
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.specialty.d: Upgrades Murloc Hunters to Murloc Warriors.
hero.naga-town.nagaheroslark.specialty.t: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Murloc Warriors
hero.naga-town.nagakarathress.biography: Deepwater Lord Karathress possesses heroic divine power and is Queen Azshara's most loyal and brave vassal. The Naga Death Warriors he leads are the most fearless warriors among the Naga Guards, always charging on the front lines of the battlefield.
hero.naga-town.nagakarathress.name: Karathress
Upgrades Naga Guards to Naga Death Warriors.
Creature Bonus: Upgrade Creature: Naga Death Warriors
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.biography: Old Sharkmouth is a hybrid of Murloc and Sea Giant, raised in the ocean arena. He defeated countless brave fighters in the ocean arena, rising from the lowest slave to the king of the arena. After countless life-and-death battles, he comprehended the power of sea fighting.
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.name: Old Sharkmouth
hero.naga-town.nagamegafin.specialty.des: Sea Fighting Power increases Old Sharkmouth's attack and defense by +5 each in sea battles.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.biography: Morogrim Tidewalker is the chieftain of the Sea Giant clan and the most powerful Tidewalker among Sea Giants. He can train Tidal Sea Giants to gain even greater power.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.name: Morogrim Tidewalker
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.specialty.de: Can upgrade Tidal Sea Giants to Sea Giant Tidewalkers.
hero.naga-town.nagamorogrim.specialty.to: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Sea Giant Tidewalkers
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.biography: In his early years, Old Blind Eye was the most skilled tomb robber among the Murlocs, able to navigate any terrain freely, but he accidentally lost his eyesight during a tomb robbery. He is now the top scout among the Murlocs; even without vision, he can accurately find the most suitable paths for marching.
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.name: Old Blind Eye
hero.naga-town.nagamurkeye.specialty.des: Provides an extra 5% bonus per level in Logistics.
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.biography: Najentus is the most proficient warrior in combat techniques among the Naga, thus granted the title of Warlord. He excels in both melee and ranged combat and has certain resistance to magic.
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.name: Warlord Najentus
hero.naga-town.naganajentus.specialty.de: Based on hero level, the base attack power of led troops increases by +1% per level, and artifact-increased hero attack increases by an extra +1% per level.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.biography: Nazjan is the leader of the Coilskar tribe and the Naga with the most 'business acumen', liking to call himself emperor, possessing unparalleled wealth.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.name: Emperor Nazjan
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.specialty.desc: Provides an extra 350 gold per day to the kingdom.
hero.naga-town.naganazjan.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.biography: Lady Naz'jar has had exceptional water magic talent since childhood, regrettably losing to Lady Vashj in a duel for ocean divine power. However, her powerful water magic remains a force that cannot be ignored.
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.name: Lady Naz'jar
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.specialty.desc: Increases water magic damage by 5% per level.
hero.naga-town.naganazjar.specialty.name: Water Magic
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.biography: Sarevess is one of the most talented sea witches among the Naga, with a unique understanding of mana, making her cast spells highly aggressive.
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.name: Sarevess
hero.naga-town.nagasarevess.specialty.de: Provides an extra 5% bonus per level in Sorcery.
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.biography: Sashj'tar is the older sister of Sasszine. Unlike Sasszine who likes researching magic, Sashj'tar is dedicated to conquering the seas and becoming a great navigator.
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.name: Sashj'tar
hero.naga-town.nagasashjtar.specialty.de: Provides an extra 5% bonus per level in Navigation.
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.biography: Sasszine is the president of the Naga Mage Guild, the most knowledgeable Naga sea witch. Her vast knowledge gives Sasszine an astonishing mana reserve, and she always likes researching magic even during wars and marches.
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.name: Sasszine
hero.naga-town.nagasasszine.specialty.de: Provides an extra 15% bonus per level in Mysticism.
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.biography: Sirakess is favored by the swift wind power and is the youngest sea witch among the Naga. During magical training, she awakened the Swift Wind Domain.
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.name: Lady Sirakess
hero.naga-town.nagasirakess.specialty.de: All creatures led by the hero gain +1 defense and +1 speed, with the defense value directly added to the hero's defense.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.biography: The ancient Teng Snake lineage is the ancestor of today's Winged Snakes and Flying Snakes. Winged Snakes and Flying Snakes were originally beast races without intelligence, tamed and subdued by the Naga. Threek once belonged to an elite Winged Snake troop of the Naga. In a battle with enemies, he accidentally fell into a deep valley, activating ancient Teng Snake remains with his weak Teng Snake bloodline, gaining ancient deadly poison divine power and awakening intelligence. Threek's blood can cause Winged Snakes to revert to Teng Snakes.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.name: Threek
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.desc: Upgrades Winged Snakes to Teng Snakes.
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.name: Teng Snakes
hero.naga-town.nagathreek.specialty.tool: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Teng Snakes
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.biography: Lady Vashj masters ocean divine power and is the strongest elemental magic user among Naga sea witches. The Naga Sea Witch troops she leads also inherit her power.
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.name: Lady Vashj
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.descr: Upgrades Naga Sea Witches to Naga Tidecallers.
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.name: Naga Tidecallers
hero.naga-town.nagavashj.specialty.toolt: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Naga Tidecallers
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.biography: Lord Xiz is the most valiant and war-skilled Venomous Fin Dragon chieftain among the Naga. He is most proud of his curse divine power, which his led Venomous Fin Dragons can inherit for greater strength.
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.name: Lord Xiz
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.descrip: Upgrades Venomous Fin Dragons to Cursed Fin Dragons.
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.name: Cursed Fin Dragons
hero.naga-town.nagaxiz.specialty.tooltip: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Cursed Fin Dragons
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.biography: Zalgira is the captain of the Naga Demon Hunter squad, and the Naga Demon Hunters she leads have superior shooting skills.
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.name: Zalgira
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.specialty.des: Upgrades Naga Sea Witches to Naga Demon Hunters.
hero.naga-town.nagazalgira.specialty.too: Creature Bonus: Creature Upgrade: Naga Demon Hunters
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.biography: Zithreen is the most restless sea witch among the Naga. In her early years, Zithreen traveled everywhere learning magic from other races. Thanks to her diligent learning and traveling, she can always incorporate various manas for her use and improve existing magic.
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.name: Zithreen
hero.naga-town.nagazithreen.specialty.de: Spell duration +1, each troop can drain 1 spell point from enemy heroes, draining an extra 1 point every 10 levels.

heroClass.naga-town.nagaseawitch.name: Naga Sea Witch
